## Is this a new integration/plugin, or a core feature?

Please check one:
- [ ] A new device type / service integration (this almost always belongs
      as a plugin — see [`docs/plugin-development.md`](../../docs/plugin-development.md)
      before filing, and consider opening a PR instead)
- [ ] A core platform feature (UI, engine, architecture)

## Problem

What problem does this solve? What's the current limitation?

What would you like to happen?

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

Mockups, links, related issues, anything else useful.
